title: Form appearance fidelity: embedded fonts and non-identity matrices
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-forms; filled appearances survive a rotated and non-identity-matrix widget on a real fixture
notes: Follow-up split from T-0234, which delivered filling, appearances, flatten and XFDF on an upright identity-matrix fixture. This task composes widget /Matrix with the page and annotation transforms, and embeds or references fonts so appearances do not depend on a Base-14 substitute, including rotated and skewed widgets and non-Latin values. Feature-matrix rows stay `library` until the T-0243 shell task exposes them; this task does not change library semantics already published.
